For [filters](/docs/shell/commands/categories/filters/).

<div class='command-title'>Transpose a matrix (swap rows and columns). For n-dimensional arrays, reverses all axes.</div>

## Command Type

`built-in`

## Signature

```> matrix transpose {flags} ```


## Input/output types:

| input  | output |
| ------ | ------ |
| matrix | matrix |
## Examples

Transpose a 2x3 matrix to a 3x2 matrix
```nu
> [[1 2 3] [4 5 6]] | into matrix | matrix transpose | matrix into-nu | to nuon
[[1.0, 4.0], [2.0, 5.0], [3.0, 6.0]]
```

Transpose an identity matrix (result is the same)
```nu
> matrix identity 2 | matrix transpose | matrix into-nu | to nuon
[[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1.0]]
```
